name: 93534 · Lancaster, CA
findings: ZIP 93534 (Lancaster) has 187 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93534 (Lancaster) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
